Organic-only reach

Sales follow your posting

Your class and courses are there every day, but mostly the women who already follow you find them. The week you post less, fewer new women see them.

Paid first step

The filter costs $447

The strategy call is a smart way to protect your time, but a woman who could invest in 3 months of 1:1 has to pay to find out if she’s a fit. Many never take that step, and spots are capped at 5 a month.

No buyer-to-applicant path

Course buyers stop at the course

Nothing walks a $97 buyer to “I’m ready for 1:1” on autopilot, with a bump and upsell that show who’s serious before she ever reaches your calendar.

Your offers are proven. What’s missing is a $27 front door that runs every day, and a free application that turns buyers into qualified 1:1 clients.

An always-on $27 entry offer, fed by Meta ads every day

It sits alongside your free masterclass, your $97 masterclasses and the Magnetic Dating Lab, not in place of them. A low-ticket kit with an order bump, an upsell and a downsell, with a free 1:1 application on the welcome page so buyers become applicants.

Meet Kelsey

Hi, I’m Kelsey Wonderlin

I’m a licensed therapist and a dating and relationship coach for women. I struggled with dating myself and couldn’t find resources that actually helped, so I built my own approach from evidence-based psychology.

Now I help women date from a secure place and find secure love without playing games. My work has been featured in The New York Times, TIME and NBC, and my courses are rated 4.9/5 by more than 2,000 students.

Is this for me if I’m dating someone new?

Yes. The kit works whether you’re on the apps, just getting started again, or a few dates into something new.

The video training is 60 minutes. You can use the questions and the checklist on your very next date.

Ad creatives · Video scripts

Ad scripts: talking to camera

Same teal backdrop and energy as your reels. 30 to 45 seconds each.

Script 1 · “The third-date questions”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here are three questions a dating coach asks clients to bring to the first three dates.”

Body

“One: what does a great relationship look like to you? Listen for specifics. Two: how do you handle it when you disagree with someone? Listen for blame. Three: what are you looking for right now? And believe the answer.”

CTA

“I put the full list, plus my red and green flag checklist, in the No-Games Dating Kit. It’s $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera on the teal backdrop, each question appears on screen as text.

Script 2 · “Chemistry isn’t compatibility”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“That instant spark isn’t always a green flag.”

Body

“Chemistry moves fast. Trust is built slowly. The women I coach who end up in secure relationships don’t ignore the spark. They just slow things down long enough to see whether the person is emotionally available, too.”

CTA

“The No-Games Dating Kit includes my 30-day pacing plan. $27, instant access. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “chemistry ≠ compatibility” with “compatibility” highlighted in pink.

Script 3 · “Mixed signals are a signal”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“A licensed therapist’s take on mixed signals.”

Body

“Hot and cold texting isn’t a puzzle to solve. It’s information. Secure dating means noticing it, saying what you want calmly, and seeing how the other person responds. No games, no decoding.”

CTA

“My message scripts for exactly that conversation are in the No-Games Dating Kit. $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a phone screen showing one of the scripts. Add “Educational content, not therapy” on screen.
